what: Unnumbered figure under Q.2 A (right column, top of printed p74): a DNA ladder of four base pairs (A=T, G≡C, T=A, C≡G) with sugar (S) pentagons and phosphate (P) dots on both strands; a black arrow points up at the dashed bonds between C and G in the bottom pair

Unnumbered figure under Q.4 B (left column, top of printed p75): two polypeptide chains each carrying an SH group (left), a reversible arrow labelled Oxidation (forward) and Reduction (back), and on the right the two chains joined by an S-S bridge
